purpose: Qualify the validation-preserving GF8 AVX2 K=2/3, R=2 packed terminal through 2 KiB against the exact Leopard main codec while bounding neighboring Leopard2 code-layout effects.

implementation.qualified_byte_rule: positive multiples of 64 through 2048 bytes on the packed ordinary and batch layouts
implementation.fallback: All ragged, aliased, sparse-output, unaligned, and out-of-range layouts retain the validated general path.
implementation.layout_control: The public and batch terminal wrappers occupy a dedicated orphan ELF section; their shared validation template is force-inlined into those wrappers so unrelated mature transform text is not displaced.

methodology.target_comparison: exact Leopard main binary over candidate Leopard2 encode time
methodology.neighbor_comparison: pre-change Leopard2 control over candidate Leopard2 encode time
methodology.statistic: One mean-log ABBA contrast per independent round; exponentiated mean and two-sided Student-t 95 percent confidence interval with df=6.
methodology.neighbor_regression_threshold: credible regression only when confidence-interval upper bound is below 0.98
methodology.isolation: Canonical build/timing lock held for each campaign; CPU 15 pinned; SMT sibling 31 idle. One core was intentional because these are cache-sensitive authoritative microbenchmarks.
methodology.immutability: Frozen executables were hashed before and after each campaign; hashes were identical. Candidate source attestation was clean in every result.

clang_asan_ubsan.broader_auto_backend_result: Resource-inconclusive in the final rerun: no sanitizer diagnostic, but the test's live set reached enforced 384 MiB and 448 MiB cgroup ceilings. The same AUTO matrix passed the clean Release gate; this resource-only failure is not counted as a sanitizer failure.

correctness_and_build_gates.benchmark_correctness: All 448 JSON invocations reported round-trip success; all four implementations in each ABBA round had identical input, parity, and recovered-output digests.

rejected_variants: A combined terminal-shape switch met the K=2/3 target but credibly regressed K=2,R=3 by about 3 percent.
Explicit EncodeInternal alignment and shape guards were slower.
A narrow K=2,R=3 direct policy improved its target but displaced unrelated text and caused larger losses.
A 4 KiB text anchor repaired immediate neighbors but produced six broad-screen losses, including three above 5 percent.
A nearby wrapper plus terminal thunks lost the K=2,64-byte gain.

known_neighbor.observation: A broader diagnostic found a credible approximately 2.6 percent code-layout regression. About 1.2 percentage points are attributable to this placement and the remainder predates it; it is tracked separately and does not invalidate the bounded T=2 acceptance neighborhood.

disposition.reason: All target confidence intervals clear the 5 percent promotion threshold, the declared neighboring gate has no credible regression over 2 percent, bit-for-bit workload digests match, and the focused correctness/sanitizer gates pass.
